description: This file defines a Python module for tracing function calls with remote logging capabilities, including a Tracer class with methods for decorating functions, capturing call details, and sending logs asynchronously.

classes.name: Tracer
classes.description: A class providing functionality to trace function calls, serialize variables, and send trace logs to a remote server.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Tracer with repository URL and server base URL.

methods.name: trace_endpoint
methods.description: Decorator to trace endpoint function calls, capturing invocation details and results.

methods.name: _send_trace_log
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the trace log to the configured endpoint, optionally saving locally during development.

methods.name: _serialize_variable
methods.description: Serializes a variable to JSON, falling back to string representation if needed.

methods.name: _get_file_tag
methods.description: Determines if a file is from the standard library, external library, or internal code based on its path.

methods.name: _setup_trace
methods.description: Sets up the tracing function with context.

methods.name: _capture_arguments
methods.description: Captures and serializes function call arguments.

methods.name: _trace_function_calls
methods.description: Handles tracing of function call, return, and exception events, recording relevant data.
